name: @mercatus-liber/adapter-shippo
description: ShippingAdapter (@mercatus-liber/shipping, epic shipping-rate-and-labels) backed by Shippo's real, current REST API: POST /shipments/ to create a Shipment and read back real carrier rates, POST /transactions/ to purchase a real label from a quoted rate, and GET /tracks/{carrier}/{tracking_number} for real tracking status. Public surface is exactly ShippingAdapter; depends on @mercatus-liber/shipping for the types it implements plus its manual adapter's carrier-detection-from-tracking-number-format helper (Shippo's tracking endpoint is addressed by carrier, but ShippingAdapter.getTrackingStatus takes only a bare tracking number), @mercatus-liber/core for the shared Money type its rate/label mapping produces, and global fetch as the real HTTP client (no new HTTP dependency introduced -- mirrors adapter-printful/adapter-printify's own convention).
